author: reek
body: End-to-end demo of the Codex web widget stack. Exercises: mount-widget-themed, dom-on-click, dom-on-input, reactive rendering via set-render / state-set-render, dialogs (show-alert, show-confirm, show-prompt), CSS animation (css-animate-spin, css-animate-pulse), ARIA accessibility (dom-set-role, dom-set-aria), and AJAX (fetch-get-then).
